name: aws-emulator
description: AWS Emulator is a local emulator of the AWS APIs.

issues.title: EC2 RevokeSecurityGroupEgress: an all-protocols rule named with FromPort/ToPort 0 does not match the default egress rule, so every Terraform aws_security_group fails
Containers can't reach the emulator by service name: the TLS certificate covers only localhost and 127.0.0.1
Add persistence to maintain data across restarts
Feature request: container support for compute services
S3 PutBucketNotificationConfiguration to SQS fails with "Unable to validate the following destination configurations" when the queue policy has a Deny statement
EC2: IPv4 prefix delegation returns 501 (CreateNetworkInterface Ipv4PrefixCount / Ipv4Prefix)
Auto Scaling: PutLifecycleHook, CompleteLifecycleAction, RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat and DescribeAutoScalingInstances return NotImplemented
